plan.description: Freeze and hash contrast, independent units, covariates, depth, filters, zero rule, diversity, permutations and FDR before counts.
Admit unique integer count identities and preserve blanks, low-depth exclusions and confounding checks.
Compute the frozen filtered CLR, Shannon, Simpson and seeded within-strata Aitchison PERMANOVA.
Compare taxa with Welch and full-family BH, retaining control and below-prevalence taxa as untested.
Register ordinary artifacts and separate bounded claims for coordinator-owned independent review.
